subject: dutch
summary: Dutch cards are clean and readable: questions are complete, the attached reading text is always the right article with no other questions on it, and where the scheme has content it is split into two or three sensible points that answer the question. The main gap is cards where the scheme has nothing: a 5-mark opinion question and the 40-mark essay both show 'The scheme prints no answer for this part' under the heading 'Select the points you actually got', with only a row of number buttons to mark yourself. Long quotations run straight into the task with no visual break, the grey language-rule note sits inside the first scheme box on every card, and no marks are shown on the points of the 30-mark and 5-mark schemes. Nothing overflows or breaks on phone or desktop.

issues.title: 'Scheme prints no answer' cards
issues.detail: Card 3 (5 marks, 2026 Q6) and card 4 (40-mark essay) show 'The scheme prints no answer for this part.' with a grey sentence ('The scheme reprints this question and prints nothing under it') and bare number buttons (0-5, or 41 buttons 0-40). The heading still says 'Select the points you actually got' and 'Select all — I had them all' though there are no points.
issues.suggested_fix: Show the general criteria for opinion answers/essays (content, coherence, language, accuracy with weightings), change the heading to 'Mark yourself', and use bands rather than 41 buttons.

issues.title: Grey language-rule note inside the scheme
issues.detail: 'The examination requires every answer in DUTCH. The paper prints the rule on page 3: "Alle antwoorden moeten in het Nederlands gegeven worden."' appears inside the first tick box of every card (above the content on cards 1 and 5, below it on card 2), and truncated in the attachment footer.

issues.title: Quotation and task run together
issues.detail: Cards 3 and 5 put the paragraph reference, a 3-4 line quotation and the actual question in one paragraph; on card 3 the quotation has no quotation marks at all, so it is hard to see where the quote ends and 'Ben je het daarmee eens of niet? Verdedig je standpunt.' begins.
issues.suggested_fix: Set the quotation as an indented block quote and the task on its own line.

issues.title: No marks on scheme points; leftover punctuation
issues.detail: Cards 1 (30 marks) and 5 (5 marks) list three points with no marks or criteria, so the tick boxes do not lead to a score. Card 1 keeps scheme typos: '–hedendaagse- media' and 'televisie.... etc.'.
issues.suggested_fix: Add the marking basis for the part; tidy the dashes and dot run.

issues.title: Essay rubric mentions several topics, shows one
issues.detail: Card 4 says 'over één van de volgende onderwerpen:' and then gives a single title on the same line.
issues.suggested_fix: Reword to 'Opstel (minimum 300 woorden):' with the title on its own line.

good_examples.why: Reference question with the paragraph cue, a one-line answer and the right text attached.
Three short, distinct scheme points that plainly answer the question.
